Crooked purple-roofed peach hotel towers on RIGHT side, irregular windows and lopsided porch, turquoise entrance, warm winding path, lush absurd green shrubs and a few eccentric travelers carrying luggage across the bottom. Bright light blue sky occupies upper and LEFT 55% with only sparse stylized clouds, leave this area visually quiet for website headline overlay. Colorful painted building and landscape concentrated right and bottom; the sky is not white. Playful skewed architecture not spooky, dramatic hand-drawn scene composition.
